identity.title: [v0.92][runtime-v3][20.c1] Add Linux service control to CSMctl

values.task_boundary: Add a fail-closed Linux process backend to CSMctl and validate it without mutating real host services.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Darwin selects the existing launchd backend
AC-2: Linux start/status/restart/stop works with isolated fixtures
AC-4: stale or foreign PID files cannot signal unrelated processes
AC-6: exact-head Gemini review has no unresolved actionable findings
